title: Sam Altman of OpenAI Pours Cold Water on AI: AI Won't Save Your Working Hours, People Will Be Busier in the Era of Super Intelligence
excerpt: July 27th news, Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, gave a cold shower to the expectation that "AI makes people work less" during his appearance on the "Relentless" podc
content_html:
July 27th news, Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, gave a cold shower to the expectation that "AI makes people work less" during his appearance on the "Relentless" podcast last Saturday. His judgment is: AI cannot help most people shorten their working hours. The main reason is that once productivity increases, people will constantly strengthen their sense of competition.

Altman mentioned that for a long time, CEOs of major technology companies have promised shorter working hours. Compared with history, people today indeed have more leisure time and improved quality of life. However, for some reason, society has never fulfilled the promise of "working four hours a week." He does not believe AI will change this.

His logic is that after AI increases productivity, people will set higher standards for themselves: "We always want more. We want to do new things and create new things for each other. This is a competition."

He continued: "I think after the arrival of the super intelligence era, we will all be busier. We will still complain about it, but deep down, we will be happier."

content_html_zh:
7 月 27 日消息，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 上周六亮相《Relentless》播客时，对“AI 让人们工作更少”的期待泼了一盆冷水。 他的判断是：AI无法帮助大多数人缩短工作时间。 主要原因是，一旦生产力提高，人们的竞争意识就会不断增强。

奥特曼提到，长期以来，各大科技公司的首席执行官都承诺缩短工作时间。 与历史相比，今天的人们确实有了更多的闲暇时间，生活质量也得到了提高。 然而，由于某种原因，社会始终没有兑现“每周工作四小时”的承诺。 他不相信人工智能会改变这一点。

他的逻辑是，人工智能提高生产力后，人们会给自己设定更高的标准：“我们总是想要更多。 我们希望为彼此做新事、创造新事物。 这是一场比赛。”

他继续说道：“我认为超级智能时代到来后，我们都会更加忙碌。 我们仍然会抱怨，但内心深处，我们会更快乐。”
